items.title: Toxic
items.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

items.title: Premada Oorali
items.overview: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

items.title: Kantara - A Legend: Chapter 1
items.overview: During the Kadamba reign, King Vijayendra, the ruler of the fictional feudatory land of Bangra, meets his final fate while venturing into the mystical forest of Kantara. items.title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
items.overview: A period drama set in the 1970s, KGF follows the story of a fierce rebel who rises against the brutal oppression in Kolar Gold Fields and becomes the symbol of hope to legions of downtrodden people.

items.title: Border Diaries
items.overview: Set in an industrial area on the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border, the story explores the lives of people working there and focuses on emotional borders, love, morality, and survival.

items.title: MissMatch
items.overview: MissMatch is a Kannada language cinema made in India. It is a family entertainer. items.title: KD – The Devil
items.overview: In the early 1970s, a petty criminal Kaali unwittingly involves himself with underworld thugs, catalyzing events beyond his control.

items.title: Roshagni
items.overview: Roshagni is an action revenge drama featuring breathtaking real stunts. The film's protagonist is driven by a quest for vengeance, navigating a story filled with intense action and drama.

items.title: Mango Pachcha
items.overview: Set in Mysuru, a crime drama unfolds across a decade (2001-2011), following a chain of events that builds tension over time. The city's setting plays a key role in reflecting different phases across the years.

items.title: 777 Charlie
items.overview: Dharma is stuck in a rut with his negative and lonely lifestyle and spends each day in the comfort of his loneliness. A pup named Charlie who is naughty and energetic which is a complete contrast with the Dharma’s character enters his life and gives him a new perspective towards it.

items.title: The Painter
items.overview: Set during the COVID-19 pandemic and filmed under lockdown condtions, this thriller follows a family attempting to deal with a possibly dangerous stranger in their home.

items.title: Tenali Rama
items.overview: Tenali Rama is the comedy film with funny dialogs.Ramesh Arvind is a B.Com graduate and Jaggesh is an S.S.L.C holder and both of them are searching the job but a fake employment agent tells them that he will take them to Dubai.

items.title: Sri Ranga
items.overview: Sri Ranga's tech savvy mother is looking for a good match for him. What will happen when he likes 2 girls?

items.title: Mutthanna
items.overview: A man and his sister are held at ransom when a rich lookalike, who moonlights as a diamond thief, forces him to take his place at social events so that the thief can carry out his illegal activities.
